map.输入纸张湿重与绝干重，计算含水率，并支持干基（以干重为基准）与湿基（以湿重为基准: Enter the wet and oven-dry weights of paper to compute moisture content, switching between dry basis (referenced to dry weight) and wet basis (referenced to wet weight). Used for moisture control in papermaking and printing workshops.
map.湿基含水率 = (湿重 - 干重) / 湿重 × 100%: Wet-basis moisture content = (wet weight - dry weight) / wet weight x 100%
map.根据纸张湿重和绝干重计算含水率，支持干基/湿基两种计算方式: Compute moisture content from the wet and oven-dry weights, with both dry-basis and wet-basis modes
map.仓储与印刷适性控制中，由湿重与干重核算湿基/干基含水率，判断纸张是否达标。: In storage and printability control, compute wet-basis/dry-basis moisture from wet and dry weights to judge whether paper meets spec.
map.平衡水分调节时，监测含水率避免印刷起皱、套印不准。: Monitor moisture content when adjusting equilibrium moisture to avoid printing wrinkles and misregistration.
map.质量争议中，以绝干率为基准核对买卖双方计量差异。: In weight disputes, use oven-dry content as the basis to reconcile buyer and seller measurements.
map.算例：湿基与干基含水率（湿重 100g，干重 92g）: Example: wet-basis and dry-basis moisture content (wet weight 100 g, dry weight 92 g)
map.：水分重=100−92=8 g；湿基含水率=8/100×100=8.00%；干基: : water weight = 100 - 92 = 8 g; wet-basis moisture = 8/100 x 100 = 8.00%; dry-basis moisture = 8/92 x 100, about 8.70%; oven-dry content = 92.00%. 8% falls within the standard moisture range (4%-10%). Formulas: wet basis = water/wet weight, dry basis = water/dry weight.
map.：湿基 4%–10% 为『标准含水率范围』；<4% 偏干、≤12% 偏高、>12: : wet basis 4%-10% is the "standard moisture range"; below 4% is too dry, up to 12% is on the high side, above 12% is excessive. Dry basis is used for laboratory oven-dry conversion and must not be confused with wet basis.
map.湿基含水率和干基含水率有何不同？: What is the difference between wet-basis and dry-basis moisture content?
map.湿基=水分÷湿重（日常常用），干基=水分÷干重（科研/贸易常用）。同一纸样干基数: Wet basis = water / wet weight (common in daily use), dry basis = water / dry weight (common in research and trade). For the same sample the dry-basis figure is slightly higher (here 8.00% versus 8.70%), so always state the basis when converting.
map.纸张标准含水率一般多少？: What is the standard moisture content of paper?
map.多数文化用纸平衡水分约 4%–10%（随相对湿度变化）。超出易导致印刷翘曲、套印: Most cultural papers have an equilibrium moisture of about 4%-10%, varying with relative humidity. Exceeding it easily causes print curl and registration errors, so storage needs temperature and humidity control.
